**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Record Android artifact verification consistently**

When this checkpoint is used to determine Android release readiness, it incorrectly lists artifact verification as a next step even though the newly committed `android12-artifact-verification.json` records the source, build, SHA-256, and signature check, and `findings.json` also marks the signed AAB as verified. The upload status is likewise inconsistent (`next step` here versus `in progress` there), so align these records to distinguish completed verification from the actual current upload state and avoid duplicate or skipped release work.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Corrected in the published successor checkpoint f2bd37f63. Android12 signed AAB hash/version verification and submissionc41e9287 are completed; Play readback is explicitly internalDRAFT. The next action is final qualified102+104 integration/build, not re-verifying or re-uploading old667. iOS21 VALID/IN_BETA_TESTING and actual publication remain separate. Current README, findings and PR body distinguish these states and preserve the versioned receipts.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh catalog reports for the new mobile candidate**

After replacing this decision with `bffc5decb0aa4633b170`, the committed generated reports still expose the removed `faf664611d7ab0aa954d` candidate and its old untranslated `NEW_USER_VISIBLE_TABS` values (`static-list-inventory.json:115080` and `list-consumer-matrix.csv:1119`). Consequently, readers of the published inventory cannot associate the updated mobile catalog with this reviewed decision, and running the documented refresh rewrites those reports; regenerate both catalog reports from the updated submodule and decision file.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Regenerated both committed reports from the published90cae070 mobile pin and the reviewed decision file in de177c858. Both strict audit commands pass:1138 candidates across1579 source files,1138 CSV rows. The replacement bffc5decb0aa4633b170 is present in JSON and CSV; removed faf664611d7ab0aa954d is absent. No generated decisions were blindly accepted or source behavior changed.
